programs.name: Adult
programs.description: General fitness and strength for adults — Gym and Home tracks every day. Hybrid programming: each day offers a full Gym version and a Home version (bodyweight, light dumbbells, bands, stability ball alternatives). Choose per day based on where you are training.

programs.name: Athletes — Speed, Strength & Conditioning
programs.description: Structured speed, strength, and conditioning for competitive athletes.

programs.name: Military Preparation
programs.description: Conditioning and resilience work to prepare for military service.

programs.name: Combat Training
programs.description: Power, agility, and fight-ready conditioning for combat athletes.

programs.name: Adolescent Training
programs.description: Age-appropriate athletic development for adolescent athletes.

programs.name: Muscle Max
programs.description: Eating approach for building lean muscle. High protein targets, peri-workout nutrition, recovery focus.

programs.name: Weight Loss
programs.description: Sustainable fat loss eating: deficit control, satiety protocols, habit stacking for long term results.

programs.name: Mom & Dads with Little Time
programs.description: Efficient strength training for busy parents — short sessions that fit real life.

programs.name: Yoga Channel
programs.description: Instructor-led yoga flows and mobility. Yoga instructors can create their own channels (Patreon-style memberships).

programs.name: John & Steph
programs.description: Recorded live sessions with John & Steph. Chronicle of coaching sessions — substitute matching days (e.g. leg day) into your regular workout programs to follow along with the recording.
